messages:
sophie (finops): Heads-up — just noticed a tax/fee line on the eu-west4 invoice that looks like it applied to our accelerator credits (GKE/TPU credits). amount = €3,240. Not in previous months.
raj (infra): which line item id? can you paste the raw line?
sophie (finops): saw it under 'TaxAdjustment' with sku=accelerator-credit and rate_type=postpaid_tax. snippet: ```lineItemId: LA-0a12b3
description: TaxAdjustment - accelerator-credit
amount: 3240.00 EUR
usagePeriod: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30```
oliver-gcp: that's odd — accelerator credits shouldn't be taxable for our contract in eu-west4. did rates change regionally?
kira-sre: pinging @oliver-gcp — can you check if there's a billing config change or a regional VAT toggle? :eyes:
oliver-gcp: opened a ticket with GCP support: INC12345678. they say there's a tax reclassification flag flipped on 2026-11-29 for eu-west4 due to partner billing flow. waiting for confirmation.
sophie (finops): nina — FYI this will skew our committed usage and reserved capacity math for Nov. we booked reserved capacity based on net charges.
nina (accounting): ack. need a temporary ledger note. do we expect a reversal?
oliver-gcp: support acknowledged it's likely a misapplied tax and said they'll either reverse or issue a credit. ETA 48h. gave provisional worklog: 
```
2026-11-29 14:12: support: tax flag toggled by partner flow
2026-11-29 15:05: support: rollback in progress
2026-11-29 16:30: support: credit queued if rollback impacts billing
```
raj (infra): can we add a quick guard in our billing parser to ignore tax lines against credits (for eu-west4) until this is resolved? otherwise dashboards show spike.
sophie (finops): yes please. add safe rule and tag rows with billing_ticket=INC12345678
kira-sre: small patch ready. will run in staging then to prod. patch sums tax lines by sku and filters if sku contains 'credit' and region == 'eu-west4' and ticket tag present.
nina (accounting): if support issues a credit, will it be a negative line or a separate credit invoice? need to know for our reconciliation.
oliver-gcp: they said they'll issue a negative invoice line (credit) referencing original lineItemId. should be visible in next billing export.
sophie (finops): cool. action items: (1) raj/kira add temporary parser rule + tag rows (2) oliver follow support and paste final note here (3) nina make ledger memo and block any automated capacity reclass for Nov.
raj (infra): starting the parser change now, will push in 15m to staging and post logs.
kira-sre: staging log after change: ```INFO filter_tax_on_credits: matched 1 line(s) for LA-0a12b3 -> tagged INC12345678```
sophie (finops): thanks — I'll hold on any reserved capacity adjustments until we see credit. :thumbsup:
oliver-gcp: update from support: they confirmed partner billing flow caused duplicate tax calc and will credit full amount within 7 business days. closing INC12345678 once credit is issued.
nina (accounting): noted. will reconcile when credit appears. add internal note: do not treat Nov as operating overcommit for reserved pool until credit posts.
sophie (finops): closing loop — patch merged to prod, dashboard spike suppressed, support ticket pending credit. I'll follow up in weekly billing sync. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Billing export for 2026-11 processed at 2026-12-01T03:12:45Z (file: gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-11/2026-11-billing.csv)
raj (infra): adding unit test to ensure future anomalies get auto-tagged.
sophie (finops): awesome, thanks team.
